Responsibility: after a user drills into a boolean bucket or an `$in` scope, "Open in list" and a related list's "View all" open exactly those rows | both are withheld for those drills since PR #30735 (and "View all" since #25888), because the route cannot say the filter | every Console user drilling a dashboard chart grouped by a yes/no field, or a measure scoped to a set of statuses
Thread-read: 6673676079
Premise: holds on `origin/main` `adf6ee094`: the route's grammar is equality to a non-empty string or finite number, the four range bounds, `[null]` and `[empty]` (`drillUrlFilters.ts:20-27`, `:64`, `:73`); `exactRecordListFilter` (`useOpenRecordList.ts:80`) refuses a boolean, `null` or `Date` comparand, `$ne`, `$in` and the text operators, and proves every accepted condition by a one-triple round trip through `parseUrlFilterTriples`. The dev measures first, per candidate (boolean comparand, `$in`, then `$ne` and the text operators), whether a written param reads back in `ObjectDataPage` as the SAME comparison the drill made (type included: a boolean must not come back as the string `'true'`), and adds a spelling only for those that do; each new spelling joins the accepted set with its own round-trip pin, and anything that cannot round-trip stays refused. The spelling must not collide with a field named like an operator suffix (the `URL_FILTER_OPS` prototype-free lookup, `:64`, stays).
Out of scope: the server's query grammar; the chart's drill scopes (landed in #30615 / #30654).
Serial constraints: the file lists of the 45 open PRs read at claim time: none touches `drillUrlFilters.ts`, `useOpenRecordList.ts` or `ObjectDataPage.tsx`. PR #30595 (#30511) adds `ObjectDataPage.filterChipI18n-9159.test.tsx` lines; whichever lands second merges the other.
